title: FBI special agents' exam data stolen in hacker attack
seoTitle: FBI agents' data stolen in hacker attack
subtitle: Blood and urine test results of special agents were compromised in a cyber intrusion.
excerpt: Blood and urine test results of FBI special agents were stolen in a hacker attack, experts say.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Blood and urine test results of special agents were stolen in a hacker attack targeting the FBI.

Experts warn that the cyber intrusion and theft of this data could leave agents vulnerable to various threats, including scams, extortion attempts, and targeted attacks.

With information from BBC News.
